new_libraries.name: VL53L5CX
new_libraries.author: Amit Kumar <amitkrcontact@gmail.com>, STMicroelectronics
new_libraries.sentence: Plug-and-play Arduino driver for the VL53L5CX 8x8 multizone Time-of-Flight sensor.
new_libraries.paragraph: Runs the VL53L5CX ULD over I2C on Arduino-compatible boards including ESP32, RP2040, SAMD, STM32, and Arduino Due.

library.name: microdsp
library.author: Aneesh Arnav Chikkala <aneesharnavchikkala@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Digital signal processing for microcontrollers: statistics, filters, FFT and calculus on fixed-size buffers or live sample streams.
library.paragraph: Provides mean, standard deviation and robust outlier detection; moving-average, median, Gaussian, FIR, Kaiser-designed and adaptive LMS/NLMS filters; an allocation-free radix-2 FFT and IFFT with Hann/Hamming/Blackman windows; numerical derivatives and integrals; and sliding-window versions of all of these for streaming sensor data. Runs on AVR as well as 32-bit targets, using no C++ standard library containers and no heap allocation in the hot paths.

library.name: NiusWireless
library.author: dunknowcoding
library.sentence: Unified Arduino driver for RFID-RC522, LoRa, NRF24L01, HC-12, HC-05/06 and PN532.
library.paragraph: Cross-platform Arduino library for wireless and RF modules. Drivers include MFRC522 (RFID/NFC over SPI and I2C, with CUID / UFUID / FUID magic-tag support), RFM9x / RA-01 / RA-02 (LoRa 433 / 470 / 868 / 915 MHz), SX1261 / SX1262 / SX1268, NRF24L01 (+), HC-12 long-range serial, HC-05 / HC-06 Bluetooth SPP, and PN532 NFC. Compatible with AVR, SAMD, ESP32, ESP8266, nRF52, STM32, RP2040 / RP2350, Renesas RA (UNO R4) and more.

library.name: tarfs
library.author: Viacheslav Logunov <vvb333007@gmail.com>
library.sentence: High-performance immutable TAR filesystem for ESP32 with mmap().
library.paragraph: Memory-efficient read-only TAR filesystem with zero-copy mmap(), POSIX-compatible API, hard links, symbolic links, long filenames, UTF-8, CRC64 integrity checking, and low RAM overhead.
